title: KOLCRAFT ENTERPRISES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (79,000 affected)
summary: THE SHOULDER STRAPS AND ASSEMBLY DO NOT FIT A CHILD SNUGLY, LEADING TO THE POSSIBILITY THAT A CHILD COULD TRAVEL TOO FAR FORWARD IN A CRASH. THIS CAUSES THE CHILD SEAT TO FAIL THE HEAD AND KNEE EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.   CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:     THE CHILD SITTING ON THE AFFECTED CHILD SEAT MAY BE  SUBJECT TO LESS PROTECTION DUE TO THE SEAT TRAVEL MOVEMENT IN A CRASH.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:SHAFT CHAIN:PROPELLOR:DRIVE (34 affected)

title: Pierce Manufacturing: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT (424 affected)

title: VIRCO MANUFACTURING CORP.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (298 affected)
summary: CHILD SEATS CONTAIN SHIELD THAT MAY CAUSE THE SEAT TO FAIL TO CONFORM TO HEAD EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (500 affected)
summary: STEERING COLUMNS CONTAIN AN INCORRECT AND POSSIBLY UNDER TORQUED COUPLING TO STEERING COLUMN CLAMPING BOLT.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: STEERING:POWER ASSIST (225 affected)

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC (213 affected)
summary: FUEL FEED AND RETURN LINE CONNECTORS HAVE INCORRECT LINE END FLARE CONFIGURATIONS.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY (14,800 affected)
summary: THE 7/8 INCH SPRING EYE BOLTS WITHIN THE SPRING EYE BUSHING HANGER BRACKET OF THE REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL.

summary: THE DIESEL FUEL FILTER SEPARATOR IS LOCATED TOO CLOSE TO THE CHASSIS FRAME CROSS MEMBER WHICH COULD DEFORM AND DISLODGE THE BOWL OF THE SEPARATOR IN AN ACCIDENT.

title: Trailmobile Canada Limited: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (70 affected)
summary: WELDS MAY BE OF POOR QUALITY, CRACKED OR MISSING FROM THE PINTLE HOOK ASSEMBLY TO THE REAR FRAME.

summary: MISMACHINING OF LOWER CRANKCASE HAS CAUSED THE OIL FILTER CASE TO BE POSITIONED INCORRECTLY.  THIS MISALIGNMENT STRESSES THE OIL AND WATER PUMPS AND COULD CAUSE ONE OR THE OTHER TO FAIL.

title: LAFORZA AUTOMOBILES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (188 affected)
summary: TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE RECOMMENDED FOR REAR TIRE WILL NOT SUPPORT GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING; ALSO, WHEEL RIMS ARE NOT STAMPED DOT.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (594 affected)
summary: BOLTS USED FOR THE BRAKE STRUT SUPPORT DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS AND MAY BREAK.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (10 affected)
summary: THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRING MAY NOT AUTOMATICALLY RETURN THE THROTTLE LEVER TO THE IDLE POSTION IN THE EVENT THAT THE LINKAGE BECOMES DISCONNECTED.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC (68 affected)
summary: ON C AND K MODELS, FEED AND OR RETURN FUEL LINES CAN CONTACT THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LINKAGE CORDON SHAFT. IN ADDITION, ON K MODELS LINES MAY ALSO CONTACT FRONT PROPSHAFT.  IN EITHER CASE THE FUEL LINES COULD BE DAMAGED RESULTING IN A FUEL LEAK.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (62,000 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, FRONT SEAT CENTER, FOLD-DOWN ARM REST MAY CONTACT THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE, CAUSING DAMAGE TO THE RELEASE BUTTON AND PREVENTING THE BELT TONGUE FROM LATCHING WHEN BUCKLING UP.
